cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Not the Real Fear
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation focused on practical details so no one reaches the fear underneath them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Before I open the scholarship letter, do we have clean teaspoons?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've made your tea. Open it; I want to know if you're leaving.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. You've put sugar in mine. I'll need another cup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Take mine. Are you frightened of going, or staying here with me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: If we swap cups, how will you know which has sugar? We need labels before anything gets mixed up.
